title: Step 60-E production Category listing
description: Productionize only /category/:slug on top of the canonical Step 60-C listing foundation and Step 60-D Search: consume generated OpenAPI GET /categories/{slug} context plus GET /categories/{slug}/products, preserve only collection cursor/limit URL state, render authoritative category context and shared ProductCard/List results, handle invalid query/not-found/no-result/bounded recovery, propagate customer-session Set-Cookie, and verify SSR. Explicitly do not consume /categories/{slug}/filters, expose brand filtering, selectable sorting, pagination/infinite controls, or mutate backend/OpenAPI/database/business authority. Perform only the minimum governed compatibility transition in historical Storefront verifiers that still require Category to remain a Step-60 placeholder.

acceptance_criteria.description: The /category/:slug loader consumes only generated OpenAPI GET /categories/{slug} context and GET /categories/{slug}/products through the existing customer-session/API bridge. No parallel category/product DTO, direct fetch transport, price/inventory authority, client-side ranking or invented category context is introduced.

Collection URL state accepts only cursor/limit at this Stage. q, brand, sort, filter and undeclared/duplicate/oversized values fail closed before any Category backend request. Opaque cursor bytes are preserved without decoding.

A valid category renders authoritative name/description and shared ListingGrid/ProductCard results in backend order. Zero products renders explicit category no-result. Category 404 renders an explicit not-found state. No /filters request, brand filter UI, selectable sort or pagination control is introduced before 60-F.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront category-listing:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/storefront static-quality

acceptance_criteria.description: Retryable GET failures use only the existing bounded safe-read policy with no polling/unbounded retry. Manual recovery preserves the validated category slug plus cursor/limit URL. Server/session Set-Cookie handling remains delegated to the existing hardened customer-session bridge.

Production SSR evidence covers ready category, invalid query with zero backend calls, not-found, no-result and bounded recovery. Persian RTL copy, logical CSS, minimum touch target and no-brown rule are preserved. Historical Step59/60-C Category-placeholder assertions are transitioned without weakening Search or later-step boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront category-listing:verify && Step 58 Storefront Quality

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical completion requires exact-head root pnpm verify, Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront quality, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before 60-F begins.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 60-E is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 60-F remains blocked until protected transport, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are green.
